what: Festival night, rehearsed (demo/src/rehearsal/domain/festival.ts): the lineup's twelve shows on three nodes, a spare that can join, and a crowd, for 60 s of simulation time with the last 20 s quiet, with every group of faults drawn from each seed (nodes, clocks, network, disks), 6 a minute and up to 2 at once. Seeds 1 to 1,000 in each network mode. A seed counts as failing an invariant if that invariant found at least one violation in its run
command: FESTIVAL_SEEDS=1000 npx vitest run test/demo/rehearsal.test.ts (the safety invariants), and the same runs counted per invariant for the table
